purpose: Selective review and reproducible computational study of DRO under stochastic volatility
prior_period_status: A preliminary single-asset analysis over 2019-2024 motivated the design; this period is exploratory.
residual_target: next-day log rolling volatility minus current log rolling volatility; zero-initialized output head; epoch zero equals persistence
forecast_validation: one preceding calendar year, selected using target availability, no test tuning
heston_calibration: annual bounded multistart simulated likelihood of daily Euler Heston return/state model under physical measure; trailing 756 returns plus 63-day conditioning warmup
drift: annual log-return mean plus half sample annual variance, fitted on calibration history, no forward returns
correlation: 252-day return correlation, 10 percent shrinkage to identity, price shocks correlated; independent residual variance shocks
covariance_ridge: 5 percent of average diagonal added to nominal scenario covariance
primary_constraints: long-only, sum risky weights = 1, no asset caps
secondary_constraints: long-only, sum risky weights <= 1, remainder in cash
adaptive_epsilon: 0.1 * sqrt(5/252) * Euclidean norm of per-asset products (forecast volatility * validation log-volatility RMSE)
ground_metric: Euclidean distance on vector five-day simple returns; CVaR penalty epsilon*norm2(w)/(1-alpha)
sensitivity_period: 2025 only; declared descriptive grid, no selection of a new primary specification
interpretation: Approximate Euler simulated likelihood is not exact continuous-time MLE or option calibration. Residual architecture/gating does not guarantee test dominance. Statistical findings are descriptive.
numerical_accuracy_extension: Tighter search and paired 20000-scenario experiments after diagnosing finite-particle and line-search effects; economic coefficients unchanged.
allocator: Full-scenario CVaR tail separation; objective contribution of tail underestimation at most 1e-10; independent epigraph checks.
